description: Équipements ruraux: eau, électricité financés par le PDRG 2007-2013 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.geoguyane.fr. Location of rural facilities financed by the French Guiana Rural Development Plan 2007-2013. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Rural facilities: Water, electricity financed by the RDPG 2007-2013" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
